transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well… mostly I’m here because I keep forgetting things I really shouldn’t. Appointments, like heart follow-ups, calling the clinic back… even showing up without the right tools when I’m supposed to fix something. It’s been causing problems.
Did these kinds of forgetfulness problems start in childhood?
Yeah… I guess so. Back in grade school I was always getting told to sit down, stop talking. I’d blurt things out, and notes would get sent home about it.
Have these problems with attention or impulsivity been present continuously since childhood?
Yeah… pretty much. It goes back as far as grade school. I was that kid who couldn’t stay in his seat, talked too much, blurted out answers… notes sent home and all that.
Do these attention problems cause trouble in more than one part of your life, like both at work and at home?

Yeah… it’s not just one place. The repair group at the senior center, they can’t really count on me like they used to. And at home, or with my own stuff… my doctor’s office has had to keep after me about missed heart follow-ups. So, yeah, it’s causing trouble.
